summary.text: The story follows five planeswalkers, Gideon Jura, Jace Beleren, Liliana Vess, Nissa Revane and Chandra Nalaar, through the moments that ignited their sparks, while Zendikar is overrun by the Eldrazi.
Gideon sees Sea Gate overwhelmed and travels to Ravnica to ask Jace for help, and Jace admits to himself that he inadvertently released the Eldrazi from their imprisonment.

Gideon and Jace then ask Chandra to join them on Zendikar, while Nissa, bonded to the land, rides the elemental Ashaya to hunt an Eldrazi titan and Liliana, trapped by her demon contract, planeswalks away.
